methods.notes: Match BLE service-data UUID 0xFCD2; the device-info byte's version field (bits5-7) must be 0b010 for v2. Then walk the object records.

manufacturer_data.description: BTHome v2 is carried in BLE SERVICE DATA (not manufacturer data) under 16-bit UUID 0xFCD2. A scanner matches on service-data UUID 0xFCD2 and reads the device-info byte (bits5-7 = 0b010 for v2).

device.name: BTHome v2 (BLE sensor broadcast format)
device.notes:
BTHome v2 is an open BLE sensor-broadcast format, decoded natively by Home Assistant and produced by ESPHome, Shelly BLU devices, ATC/pvvx custom Mijia firmware, b-parasite and many DIY nRF52 sensors. A BTHome-native device spec should cite this file rather than restating the object table.
WIRE FORMAT: advertised in BLE Service Data under 16-bit UUID 0xFCD2 (on-air little-endian D2 FC). After the UUID comes a device-information byte: bit0 = encryption flag (0 unencrypted / 1 encrypted), bit2 = trigger-based/irregular interval, bits5-7 = BTHome version (0b010 = v2). Example 0x40 = v2, unencrypted, regular interval. The payload is a sequence of object records, each = 1-byte object id + its little-endian value; a packet may carry several.
OBJECT IDS (subset; the bthome.io/format table is authoritative):
  0x01 battery u8 1 % ; 0x02 temperature s16 x0.01 C ; 0x03 humidity u16
  x0.01 % ; 0x04 pressure u24 x0.01 hPa ; 0x05 illuminance u24 x0.01 lux ;
  0x06 mass u16 x0.01 kg ; 0x0A energy u24 x0.001 kWh ; 0x0B power u24 x0.01 W
  ; 0x0C voltage u16 x0.001 V ; 0x0D pm2.5 u16 ug/m3 ; 0x0E pm10 u16 ug/m3 ;
  0x12 CO2 u16 ppm ; 0x13 TVOC u16 ug/m3 ; 0x14 moisture u16 x0.01 % ; 0x3F
  rotation s16 x0.1 deg ; 0x40 distance u16 mm ; 0x41 distance u16 x0.1 m ;
  0x43 current u16 x0.001 A ; 0x45 temperature s16 x0.1 C ; 0x50 timestamp
  u32 epoch ; 0x51 acceleration u16 x0.001 m/s2 ; 0x56 conductivity u16 uS/cm.
  Binary sensors are single u8 (0/1) ids: 0x0F generic, 0x11 opening, 0x15
  battery-low, 0x16 charging, 0x1A door, 0x21 motion, 0x23 occupancy, 0x2D
  window. Events: 0x3A button, 0x3C dimmer. Device meta: 0xF0 device-type id
  (u16), 0xF1 firmware version (u32).

ENCRYPTION: AES-CCM, 16-byte key. Nonce (13 bytes) = MAC(6) + UUID-reversed(2) + device-info byte(1) + counter(4, LE). A 4-byte LE counter increments every advertisement; a 4-byte MIC authenticates. Encrypted service-data layout = UUID(2) + device-info(1) + ciphertext + counter(4) + MIC(4).

openness.notes: Published open standard (project by the Home Assistant community). Native in Home Assistant and ESPHome; nothing was reverse-engineered. Consult bthome.io/format for the complete, authoritative object-id list.
